summary: Depth 5 and Depth 20 clients on one NSE equity: the instrument's book subscription moves to 20 levels (a PUT and a POST of 1502, the one code both depths use), and a 1502 event's twenty levels reach the Depth 20 client whole and the Depth 5 client cut to five.

notes: Each Depth holder gets the levels it asked for (feed/protocol/market.rs book_for, cut to the holder's depth; audit P-10). XTS has no deeper socket: both depths come from the one 1502 subscription, held at the deepest depth asked for (websocket::manager registry).
The web publishes each 1502 once, and its listener sends it to every Depth client of the symbol whatever depth it asked for, so its Depth 5 client gets twenty levels.

deviations.reason: XTS sent average_price in the 1502 event's Touchline; this web adapter's Depth data drops it (mode 3 keeps ltp, ltt, volume, OHLC, oi, the circuits and the book), the desktop's Depth frame keeps it: data the broker sent, lost from a mode (lead decision, night of 9 Nov).

The web publishes each 1502 book once, and its listener sends it to every Depth client of the symbol whatever depth that client asked for, so this Depth 5 client gets the twenty levels a Depth 20 client asked for. The desktop gives each Depth holder the levels it asked for: the Depth 20 client the twenty, this one the first five (feed/protocol/market.rs book_for; audit P-10, lead ruling).
deviations.ref: websocket_proxy/server.py (a Depth publish to every Depth client of the symbol); compositedge_adapter.py _extract_depth_data

The 1502 event carries no LowerCircuitLimit; the web sends lower_circuit 0 for it (message.get('LowerCircuitLimit', 0)), the desktop leaves it out (docs: a field the stream does not carry is left out).

The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST): a wrong unit, since feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in milliseconds (1794199530000).
The 1502 event carries no OpenInterest; the web sends oi 0 for it (message.get('OpenInterest', 0)), the desktop leaves it out (docs: a field the stream does not carry is left out).
